title: Where did the export failures go?
description: One window of 10,000 requests as a solid whose amber floor holds 40 failures; split it by version and by operation to see what the pooled rate conceals.
initialCaption: Footprint = requests; amber height = aggregate error rate. Pooled, the 40 v2 export failures are a 0.4% hairline at the base.
interactionHint: Drag to look around · scroll to zoom
fallback: Pooled across all 10,000 requests, 40 failures make a 0.4% layer. Splitting by version alone gives 4%, and only splitting by both version and operation shows v2 exports failing at 40% (40 of 100) while v1 exports fail at 0 of 900.
